rows.grounds: first member of compound bāṇa-puṅkha, arrow-feather
second member of compound bāṇa-puṅkha, fletching of an arrow
feminine adjective agreeing with khaṭvā from prior context, describing constant alignment

items.question: What manner of steadfast alignment characterizes the ever-unbroken support?
premises: An arrow moves in alignment with its feather.
The support is described as following in that manner.
Such following implies unwavering and directed adherence.
items.inference: The ever-unbroken support maintains a constant, unwavering alignment like an arrow following its feather.
uncertainties: The precise metaphorical referent of the alignment depends on the broader context of khaṭvā.
items.plain_english: It follows like the feather of an arrow.
